questions.question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'**

She's considered one/of a best young/directors in Hollywood.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**of a best young.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The correct phrase is "one of the best young directors", not "of a best young".
 
• The error is in the use of the article "a" before "best young".
 
• **The word "best" is the superlative form of the adjective "good."**
 
• **The article 'the' precedes the superlative form of the adjective.**
 
• This is because there's only one (or one group) of the thing we are talking about. 
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be read as:
 
 
• She's considered one of the best young directors of Hollywood.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

questions.question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The accountant of the sugar mill __have been deprived__ of his briefcase.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**has been deprived.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the present perfect tense, indicating that the action occurred in the past and has ongoing effects in the present.
 
• **"Has been" is the correct auxiliary verb to use with 'deprived' in the present perfect tense.**
 
• The choice between 'has' and 'have' depends on its subject.
 
• Has is used with singular subjects while "have" is used with plural subjects.
 
• **In the given sentence, the subject "accountant" is a singular subject. **
 
• **Thus, we will use the verb "has" in the sentence.**
 
• The correct sentence will be: The accountant of the sugar mill has been deprived of his briefcase.

 Hence, **the correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Was being deprived' is in the past continuous tense, indicating an ongoing action in the past.
 
• 'Is deprive' is not a correct verb tense or form.

• Thus, the subject is in agreement with the verb.
 
• "Only when they mate" is a correct adverbial phrase that modifies "ovulate."
 
• "Including rabbits and cats" is a correct participial phrase that modifies "female mammals."

Hence, the **correct answer is option 1**.
